mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.island_id AS "islandId", p.pool_kind AS "poolKind", p.strategy, p.skip_on_error AS "skipOnError", p.skip_on_offline AS "skipOnOffline", p.allow_iteration_on_error AS "allowIterationOnError", p.min_nest_count AS "minNestCount", p.enabled, (SELECT count(*) FROM device_pool_member m WHERE m.pool_id = p.id AND m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id) AS "memberCount" FROM device_pool p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{t} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.island_id = #{islandId} AND p.pool_kind = #{kind} ORDER BY p.id

SELECT id, code, name, island_id AS "islandId", pool_kind AS "poolKind", strategy, skip_on_error AS "skipOnError", skip_on_offline AS "skipOnOffline", allow_iteration_on_error AS "allowIterationOnError", min_nest_count AS "minNestCount", enabled FROM device_pool WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.id, m.pool_id AS "poolId", m.device_instance_id AS "deviceInstanceId", m.sub_group AS "subGroup", m.priority, m.use_count AS "useCount", di.code AS "deviceCode", r.code AS "deviceResourceCode" FROM device_pool_member m JOIN device_instance di ON di.id = m.device_instance_id LEFT JOIN resource_node r ON r.id = di.resource_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{t} AND m.pool_id = #{poolId} ORDER BY m.priority, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_pool (tenant_id, code, name, island_id, pool_kind, strategy, skip_on_error, skip_on_offline, allow_iteration_on_error, min_nest_count) VALUES (#{t}, #{code}, #{name}, #{islandId}, #{poolKind}, #{strategy}, #{skipOnError}, #{skipOnOffline}, #{allowIterationOnError}, #{minNestCount})
mapper.update:
UPDATE device_pool
name = #{name}, strategy = #{strategy}, skip_on_error = #{skipOnError}, skip_on_offline = #{skipOnOffline}, allow_iteration_on_error = #{allowIterationOnError}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE device_pool SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_pool_member (tenant_id, pool_id, device_instance_id, sub_group, priority) VALUES (#{t}, #{poolId}, #{deviceInstanceId}, #{subGroup}, #{priority}) ON CONFLICT (pool_id, device_instance_id) DO UPDATE SET sub_group = EXCLUDED.sub_group, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, updated_at = now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM device_pool_member WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND pool_id = #{poolId} AND device_instance_id = #{deviceInstanceId}
mapper.select: SELECT device_id FROM device_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{deviceInstanceId}
SELECT count(*) FROM node_binding WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND pool_id = #{poolId}

SELECT dp.id AS "positionId", pr.code AS "positionCode", pr.id AS "pointResourceId", dp.point_role AS "pointRole", dp.robot_reachable AS "robotReachable", dp.device_resource_id AS "deviceResourceId", dr.code AS "deviceCode" FROM device_point dp JOIN resource_node pr ON pr.id = dp.point_resource_id LEFT JOIN resource_node dr ON dr.id = dp.device_resource_id WHERE dp.tenant_id = #{t} AND dp.id = #{positionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position_method (tenant_id, position_id, method_id, scope_kind, scope_id, purpose, allocation, priority) VALUES (#{t}, #{positionId}, #{methodId}, #{scopeKind}, #{scopeId}, #{purpose}, #{allocation}, #{priority})
mapper.update: UPDATE position_method SET purpose = #{purpose}, allocation = #{allocation}, priority = #{priority}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT dp.id AS "positionId", pr.code AS "positionCode", dr.code AS "deviceCode", pm.id AS "bindingId", dm.method AS "methodName", pm.scope_kind AS "scopeKind", pm.scope_id AS "scopeId", pm.purpose, pm.enabled FROM device_point dp JOIN resource_node pr ON pr.id = dp.point_resource_id LEFT JOIN resource_node dr ON dr.id = dp.device_resource_id LEFT JOIN position_method pm ON pm.position_id = dp.id AND pm.tenant_id = dp.tenant_id LEFT JOIN device_method dm ON dm.id = pm.method_id WHERE dp.tenant_id = #{t} AND dr.parent_id = #{islandId} ORDER BY dr.code, pr.code, pm.scope_kind, pm.id

SELECT nb.id, nb.node_id AS "nodeId", nb.seq, nb.position_id AS "positionId", nb.device_instance_id AS "deviceInstanceId", nb.pool_id AS "poolId", nb.method_id AS "methodId", nb.material_role AS "materialRole", nb.loading_pattern AS "loadingPattern", nb.leave_at_station AS "leaveAtStation", nb.barcode_policy AS "barcodePolicy", nb.params, nb.enabled, pr.code AS "positionCode", dm.method AS "methodName" FROM node_binding nb LEFT JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = nb.position_id LEFT JOIN resource_node pr ON pr.id = dp.point_resource_id LEFT JOIN device_method dm ON dm.id = nb.method_id WHERE nb.tenant_id = #{t} AND nb.node_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY nb.seq, nb.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO node_binding (tenant_id, node_id, seq, position_id, device_instance_id, pool_id, method_id, material_role, loading_pattern, leave_at_station, barcode_policy, params) VALUES (#{t}, #{nodeId}, #{seq}, #{positionId}, #{deviceInstanceId}, #{poolId}, #{methodId}, #{materialRole}, #{loadingPattern}, #{leaveAtStation}, #{barcodePolicy}, #{params}::jsonb)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM node_binding WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND node_id = #{nodeId}
mapper.select: SELECT wn.node_key AS "nodeKey", di.id AS "instanceId", dp.device_resource_id AS "deviceResourceId" FROM node_binding nb JOIN workflow_node wn ON wn.id = nb.node_id JOIN device_point dp ON dp.id = nb.position_id JOIN device_instance di ON di.resource_id = dp.device_resource_id WHERE nb.tenant_id = #{t} AND wn.workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND nb.enabled = true AND nb.position_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_node SET binding_mode = #{mode}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND node_key = #{nodeKey}
mapper.select: SELECT id, role_code AS "roleCode", display_name AS "displayName", physical_type AS "physicalType", plate_type AS "plateType", max_height_mm AS "maxHeightMm", lid_role_code AS "lidRoleCode", barcode_regex AS "barcodeRegex", auto_barcode_prefix AS "autoBarcodePrefix" FROM material_role WHERE tenant_id = #{t} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_role (tenant_id, role_code, display_name, physical_type, plate_type, max_height_mm, lid_role_code, barcode_regex, auto_barcode_prefix) VALUES (#{t}, #{roleCode}, #{displayName}, #{physicalType}, #{plateType}, #{maxHeightMm}, #{lidRoleCode}, #{barcodeRegex}, #{autoBarcodePrefix})
mapper.update: UPDATE material_role SET display_name = #{displayName}, physical_type = #{physicalType}, plate_type = #{plateType}, max_height_mm = #{maxHeightMm}, barcode_regex = #{barcodeRegex}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM material_role WHERE tenant_id = #{t} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT dp.id FROM device_point dp WHERE dp.tenant_id = #{t} AND dp.device_resource_id = #{deviceResourceId} AND (dp.is_standalone = true OR (dp.robot_reachable = true AND dp.is_entry = true)) ORDER BY dp.is_standalone DESC, dp.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transport_segment (tenant_id, run_id, run_node_id, seq, robot_resource_id, from_position_id, to_position_id, carrier, status, created_at) VALUES (#{t}, #{runId}, #{runNodeId}, #{seq}, #{robotResourceId}, #{fromPositionId}, #{toPositionId}, #{carrier}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT rn.id, rn.code, rn.name, rn.parent_id AS "deviceResourceId", dp.id AS "pointId", dp.workstation_slot AS "slot", ps.plate_id AS "plateId", ps.occupied_by_run AS "occupiedByRun" FROM resource_node rn LEFT JOIN device_point dp ON dp.point_resource_id = rn.id AND dp.tenant_id = rn.tenant_id LEFT JOIN position_state ps ON ps.resource_id = rn.id AND ps.tenant_id = rn.tenant_id WHERE rn.tenant_id = #{t} AND rn.kind = 'workstation' AND rn.parent_id = #{deviceResourceId} ORDER BY dp.workstation_slot NULLS LAST, rn.code

SELECT dp.id FROM device_point dp JOIN resource_node rn ON rn.id = dp.point_resource_id AND rn.kind = 'workstation' WHERE dp.tenant_id = #{t} AND dp.device_resource_id = #{deviceResourceId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM position_state ps WHERE ps.resource_id = rn.id AND ps.plate_id IS NOT NULL AND ps.plate_id <> '') ORDER BY dp.workstation_slot NULLS LAST, dp.id LIMIT 1
